title: Under-salted, tender Saudi Arabian goose tagine
description: Sweet and tender, this one-pot dish is a unique twist on traditional Middle Eastern cuisine. Featuring goose fat and carefully selected spices, it's a vegan-friendly main course that's perfect for a solo dinner.

ingredients.name: Goose, boned and cut into 2-inch pieces

instructions: Season the goose pieces with turmeric, cumin, coriander, and black pepper.
Heat 2 tablespoons of date syrup in the salt block over medium heat. Sear the goose pieces until browned on all sides.
Remove the goose from the salt block and set aside.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the salt block and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the water, lemon juice, and date syrup to the salt block. Stir to combine.
Return the goose pieces to the salt block and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Cover the salt block with a lid and transfer it to the oven. Cook for 2 hours, or until the goose is tender.
Remove the salt block from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Garnish with chopped mint leaves and serve immediately.
